images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a real setup-guide screenshot. Input image is the edit target. Redact the entire access key ID value and the entire secret access key value in the central Retrieve access keys table. Also redact any account name or account ID in the top right navigation. Use fully opaque solid dark rectangles labelled REDACTED in white. Remove all underlying sensitive text completely; do not blur, pixelate, reveal partial identifiers, invent replacement keys, or reproduce any credential elsewhere. Preserve all other interface text, buttons, layout, colors, and framing exactly. The result must remain a legible instructional screenshot. Output one edited image.
